scope: Post-failure prompt/schema factorial diagnostic on observed briefs, not heldout improvement or Harness2 learning. Original/free cell reused from earlier run; remaining cells run later. No claim of isolated token-level causal mechanism.

cases.request: Take four soft steps: left, right, left, right. Return to the starting position.
Take four clear steps: left, right, left, right. Return to the starting position.
Step left twice, then right twice. Keep every step soft except the final right step, which is clear.
Step right clearly, right softly, left softly, then right clearly. Finish 0.4 metres right of the start.

explicit_free.system: Return only a JSON object with one field named moves: an array of exactly four pairs, in chronological order. Each pair contains two strings. The first string must be step_left or step_right. The second string must be soft or clear. Choose one identifier per string, never alternatives or coordinates. Every move is a two-beat side step at 120 BPM. Each step moves the planted stance 0.20 m in its named direction. Variation changes arm/body accent, not travel distance. No other fields. World +x is right; -x is left. Each step moves the actor exactly 0.20 metres in its named direction. Start at x=0. Use exact move and variation identifiers.

original_enum.system: Return strict JSON only: {"moves":[["step_left|step_right","soft|clear"],["step_left|step_right","soft|clear"],["step_left|step_right","soft|clear"],["step_left|step_right","soft|clear"]]}. Four chronological two-beat side steps at 120 BPM. Each step moves the planted stance 0.20 m left or right. Variation affects arm/body accent, not travel distance. No other fields. World +x is right; -x is left. Each step moves the actor exactly 0.20 metres in its named direction. Start at x=0. Use exact move and variation identifiers.
